cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Assessment Methodologies is 25 percent of the exam: passive and active recon, Nmap host and port scanning, service enumeration and vulnerability assessment. Most exam questions start with which host runs X or what version is Y.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: Discover hosts with nmap -sn, run a full TCP scan with nmap -p- --min-rate 3000, then deep-scan open ports with -sC -sV -O. Enumerate SMB, FTP, SSH, HTTP and MySQL, record versions, and check them with searchsploit. Compare manual findings with a Nessus Essentials scan.

questions.a: Host discovery without a port scan.

questions.q: Why do a full port scan before a deep scan?
questions.a: To find all open ports first, then run slow scripts and version detection only on those.
